title: I Saw An Old Friend In Burma
blurb:
The ferry from Rangoon to Port Blair carries soldiers, prisoners, and old friends.

When the newly appointed governor of a remote island prison encounters an old friend who doesn't seem to recognise him, he finds the man has changed a lot in the twenty years since the war.

Over the course of three days at sea, the two men become drawn to each other, and the governor is forced to question realities that had always been taken for granted.

By the time land appears on the horizon, the man who boarded the ferry is no more, and in his place stands someone else, who is just beginning to see the world through different eyes.
